footer.tagline: Scholarships and jobs matched to your qualifications — with reasons on every card.
footer.disclaimer: Opportunistic™ surfaces third-party listings and is not the issuer of any scholarship or job. Verify deadlines and eligibility on the source site. We apply a GDPR-style privacy baseline globally; cookie and analytics tools load only with your consent.

cookies.caption: Privacy controls
cookies.title: Cookies & data use
cookies.body: We use necessary cookies to keep you signed in and remember this choice. Optional cookies help preferences, analytics, and marketing — only if you allow them. Aligns with GDPR-style rights worldwide.
cookies.prefsBody: Change anytime. Necessary cookies can’t be turned off — they power auth, security, and storing this choice.
cookies.preferencesDesc: Remember UI choices beyond the consent cookie
cookies.analyticsDesc: Understand usage (loaded only after you opt in)
cookies.marketingDesc: Ads / remarketing tags — never without consent
